description: Find ACA Marketplace plans for a household, with the premium tax credit applied and plans ranked by estimated total yearly cost. Also reports the monthly tax credit, cost-sharing reduction (extra-savings Silver) eligibility and likely Medicaid eligibility.

ages.description: Age of each person who needs coverage

annual_income.description: Expected household income (MAGI) for the coverage year, in dollars. Needed for the tax credit.

expected_care.description: checkups = preventive only; some = a few visits; ongoing = a chronic condition or regular meds

household_size.description: People in the tax household, including those not enrolling. Defaults to the number of ages.

immigration_status.description: Per person, same order as ages. citizen = U.S. citizen or national; eligible-alien = green card holder, Cuban/Haitian entrant or COFA migrant; lawfully-present = work or student visa, asylum, refugee, TPS, pending green card; not-lawfully-present = no lawful status, including DACA. From 2027 only citizens and eligible aliens get the tax credit. Defaults to citizen.

tobacco.description: Tobacco use per person, same order as ages

name: search_plans
title: Search health plans
